# Top Speed Appliance — Top Speed Service OS

> Top Speed Appliance LLC is an appliance repair, installation, sales and delivery company serving Florida's tri-county area (Broward, Palm Beach and Miami-Dade counties). Bookings, dispatch and live job tracking run on the Top Speed Service OS platform. Slogan: "The Faster, The Better."

## Contact

- Phone: (844) 460-7038
- Service area: 65 cities across Broward, Palm Beach & Miami-Dade — a service-area business; repairs happen at your home or business (no public street address)
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM
- Website: https://topspeedserviceos.com/

## Services

- Refrigerator repair
- Washer repair
- Dryer repair
- Oven and range repair
- Dishwasher repair
- Freezer and ice maker repair
- Microwave repair
- Garbage disposal repair
- Appliance installation

Service details: https://topspeedserviceos.com/service

## Pricing (residential)

- Diagnostic: $99, collected at booking and credited toward an approved repair. The diagnostic is still due if the repair is declined.
- Repair labor: $210 flat.
- Installation labor: $150 flat.
- Parts and materials are priced in a written quote. No work is done without an approved written quote.
- Commercial service is priced by custom quote only — see Appliance Pro (https://www.appliancepro.net/).

## Programs

- Refer & Earn: customers earn a $25 credit for each completed referral (higher tiers for repeat referrers); the referred friend receives $25 off their first repair. https://appliancereferral.com
- Track My Tech: customers receive their technician's photo and a live tracking link when the tech is on the way.

- Residential repair site: https://www.topspeedappliance.net/
- Commercial service (custom quote only): https://appliancepro.net

## Coverage

- 65 cities across Broward (31), Palm Beach (16) and Miami-Dade (18) counties are matched automatically when booking; the platform publishes 131 local pages (65 city pages and 66 service pages).
- Coverage directory: https://topspeedserviceos.com/service-areas-directory/

## Booking

- Book online with the classic web form: https://topspeedserviceos.com/book
- Or ask Speedy, the AI service assistant on the site — Speedy summarizes your request and asks for your confirmation before anything is sent to the Service Setters office.
- Every job is confirmed by a human Service Setter and tracked live from request to completion.

## Referrals

- Refer & Earn: customers earn credit for every referred friend whose Top Speed job is completed. https://topspeedserviceos.com/refer

## Network partner

- Cleanout Vents is the Top Speed network's registered partner for dryer vent cleaning, vent repair and vent rerouting, reachable through Top Speed: https://topspeedserviceos.com/cleanout-vents-site or by calling (844) 460-7038. Vent services are quoted by Cleanout Vents; Top Speed does not publish vent prices.

## One platform — Top Speed Service OS

Top Speed Appliance LLC runs on one platform: Top Speed Service OS (https://topspeedserviceos.com). Every door below is the same company and the same Service Setters dispatch queue — customer site, provider network, marketplace and media all resolve to Top Speed Appliance LLC.

- Customer site & booking: https://topspeedserviceos.com
- Residential repair site: https://www.topspeedappliance.net/
- Provider network (join, network businesses, dispatch): https://topspeedapplianceservice.com/

## The enterprise — Top Speed OS

Top Speed OS is the main division of Top Speed Appliance LLC — the parent structure for the whole enterprise and every platform in it. Enterprise hub: https://topspeedserviceos.com/top-speed-os

- Top Speed OS (parent division): the enterprise structure that organizes every Top Speed platform. https://topspeedserviceos.com/top-speed-os
- Top Speed Service OS (service division): the service side of the business — appliance repair and installation, booking, Service Setters dispatch, live job tracking and the provider network, across 65 cities in Broward, Palm Beach and Miami-Dade. https://topspeedserviceos.com
- Top Speed Sales OS (retail division): the retailing side — the Sales OS console and the Top Speed Appliances shop for used appliances. Console: https://topspeedserviceos.com/sales-os · Shop: https://topspeedappliances.com
- Media OS: Top Speed's social and video library. https://topspeedserviceos.com/media
- Pepper Lists: the Top Speed marketplace — buy, sell and book in one app. https://pepperlists.com
- Speedy AI: the AI service assistant on Top Speed surfaces — questions, photo diagnosis and booking help. https://topspeedserviceos.com/speedy
- Refer & Earn: the referral program — $25 credit per completed referral; the referred friend gets $25 off their first repair. https://topspeedserviceos.com/refer

## Advertising — Flywheel AI Advertising / Top Speed Ads

Flywheel AI Advertising is Top Speed's own in-house advertising system, run as Top Speed Ads on the same Service OS platform. House campaigns run on Top Speed's own surfaces with no outside ad spend; campaigns are prepared by Pepper Agent and go live only with the owner's approval.

- Flywheel AI Advertising — the advertising system: https://topspeedserviceos.com/flywheel
- Top Speed Ads — Ad Studio (build and review campaigns): https://topspeedserviceos.com/ad-studio
- AdStream — the streaming ad channel: https://topspeedserviceos.com/adstream
- Ads OS — advertising operations: https://topspeedserviceos.com/ads
- Marketing OS — marketing operations and city pages: https://topspeedserviceos.com/marketing-os
- Local OS — local presence, directories and city coverage: https://topspeedserviceos.com/local
- Advertise on Top Speed (for outside businesses): https://topspeedserviceos.com/advertise
- Advertiser Console (advertiser sign-in): https://topspeedserviceos.com/advertiser
